design_summary: Defines the game's visual identity: 16-bit retro pixel art with a warm bakery/candy palette, 1px outlines, multi-tone shading, and per-class color schemes. Specifies sprite sheet sizes, animation guidelines, and environment themes per tower. Backs the Art Style Overhaul epic.

epics.title: Art Style Overhaul
epics.summary: Replace all placeholder pixel art with polished retro-style assets across characters, bosses, enemies, items, environment tiles, and UI. Follows the art style guide's bakery/candy palette, 1px outlines, and multi-tone shading. Shipped in the initial baseline as spritesheets for all five classes, four bosses, enemies, and items.
